Specification: A set of formal TLA+ proofs for the Boyer-Moore Majority Vote algorithm. It establishes technical lemmas regarding the indexing of node positions and occurrence counts, proves the type invariant, and verifies the final correctness property by demonstrating that the algorithm maintains a safety invariant across all valid state transitions.
TheoremNames: LEMMA PositionsType == \A v, j : PositionsBefore(v,j) \in SUBSET (1 .. j-1)
LEMMA PositionsFinite == ASSUME NEW v, NEW j \in Int PROVE IsFiniteSet(PositionsBefore(v,j))
LEMMA PositionsPlusOne == ASSUME TypeOK, NEW j \in 1 .. Len(seq), NEW v PROVE PositionsBefore(v, j+1) = IF seq[j] = v THEN PositionsBefore(v,j) \union {j} ELSE PositionsBefore(v,j)
LEMMA OccurrencesType == \A v : \A j \in Int : OccurrencesBefore(v,j) \in Nat
LEMMA OccurrencesPlusOne == ASSUME TypeOK, NEW j \in 1 .. Len(seq), NEW v PROVE OccurrencesBefore(v, j+1) = IF seq[j] = v THEN OccurrencesBefore(v,j) + 1 ELSE OccurrencesBefore(v,j)
IfThenElse: IF seq[j] = v THEN PositionsBefore(v,j) \union {j} ELSE PositionsBefore(v,j) (in PositionsPlusOne)
IF seq[j] = v THEN OccurrencesBefore(v,j) + 1 ELSE OccurrencesBefore(v,j) (in OccurrencesPlusOne)
AssumeProveBlocks: ASSUME NEW v, NEW j \in Int PROVE IsFiniteSet(PositionsBefore(v,j))
ASSUME TypeOK, NEW j \in 1 .. Len(seq), NEW v PROVE PositionsBefore(v, j+1) = IF seq[j] = v THEN PositionsBefore(v,j) \union {j} ELSE PositionsBefore(v,j)
ASSUME TypeOK, NEW j \in 1 .. Len(seq), NEW v PROVE OccurrencesBefore(v, j+1) = IF seq[j] = v THEN OccurrencesBefore(v,j) + 1 ELSE OccurrencesBefore(v,j)
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, Inv, Next PROVE Inv'
ASSUME NEW v \in Value \ {seq[i]} PROVE 2 * OccurrencesBefore(v, i+1) <= (i+1) - 1 - 1
ASSUME NEW v \in Value \ {cand'} PROVE 2 * OccurrencesBefore(v, i') <= i' - 1 - cnt'
